sources.name: Call of Duty: Zombies Guides — interactive map
sources.note: Area labels and service coordinates from the public map, paired with its 2048 × 2048 Activision background (/layers/totenreich/totenreich-eidskallen-layer.webp). The separate Mister Peeks marker group supplies Cursed reward spawn candidates, distinct from music, relic and doll quests.

layers.label: Overview
layers.note: Full tactical overview. Room highlights indicate an area, while service pins use published marker coordinates. Interior floors can overlap.

layers.label: Dravakar’s Fall
layers.note: Separate boss arena. The three Flammenfalle traps use published coordinates; the boss and attack targets move.

locations.label: Eidskallen Landing
locations.description: Spawn region around Quick Revive and the Riese head.

locations.label: Eidskallen Square
locations.description: Village square around Stamin-Up and the routes to the landing and hall.

locations.label: Dry Dock
locations.description: Dock area around Speed Cola, PhD Flopper and Melee Macchiato. Search the boat and buildings described by the guide.

locations.label: Titan Crane / Dry Dock
locations.description: Crane room at the north end of Dry Dock. Use its timed button, then wall-jump to the ship bow for the chain links.

locations.label: Machine Workshop / Dry Dock
locations.description: Upper room on the southwestern side of Dry Dock, reached by clearing the 02 Building stairs with Wunderbarrage. Contains the claw machine and upper gnome catwalk.

locations.label: Core Foundry
locations.description: Western foundry rooms, near the VS Recon wall-buy. The ARC-XD vent leads across the water to the Genetic Lab; the Ascender reaches the radio console.

locations.label: Group 935 Genetic Lab
locations.description: Lab on Fishery Island, opened by sending the ARC-XD across from Core Foundry. Enter from the Pack-a-Punch side for the jars, Necrospike and Uranium cell.

locations.label: War Factory
locations.description: Western factory building next to Core Foundry. The crate sits near the Admin room entrance.

locations.label: Storm Bridge
locations.description: Northern bridge between Tyr’s Foot and Tyr’s Shoulder. The Chilly Chunks truck and charged-core barrel are on this bridge.

locations.label: Tyr’s Foot
locations.description: Northwestern foot of the giant robot. Enter Tyr here, and search nearby for the note and Dravakar Shard.

locations.label: Tyr’s Head
locations.description: Tyr’s interior is drawn separately as the small circle north of Storm Bridge. The transmitter and blinking lights are on the second floor; the console launches the boss encounter.

locations.label: Tyr’s Shoulder
locations.description: Northeastern shoulder of the giant robot. Upper access to Tyr and a fishing spot.

locations.label: Fjord Road
locations.description: Southern road connecting the landing to Dry Dock. Check the checkpoint near the Flammenfalle trap for the flak-round crate.

locations.label: Fishery Island
locations.description: Central island containing Juggernog and the Glocke Drop Pack-a-Punch landing.

locations.label: Skallen Market
locations.description: Market around Mule Kick. Place Chilly Chunks on the central table and search nearby houses for side-quest items.

locations.label: Burial Grounds
locations.description: Northeastern burial region and shrine, beyond the church. Use the chain links at the door and match the constellations.

locations.label: Eidskallen Stave Church
locations.description: Church just west of Burial Grounds, north of Skallen Market. Place the Sunstone on its central altar.

locations.label: Blodheim Hall
locations.description: Feasting hall around Vulture Aid. Its central bonfire, bear pelts and helmet displays serve several quests.

locations.label: Loven’s Antiquities
locations.description: Antiquities shop in the northwestern part of Eidskallen Square. Search its shelves for headphones and the counter for the Kneehigh Helm.

locations.label: Beacon Island
locations.description: Southeastern island with the Lighthouse, arsenal, Wunderfizz and fishing access.

locations.label: Lighthouse
locations.description: Tower on Beacon Island. Jotunn Star is in the top chamber; the Crowbar is on an interior shelf.

targets.title: Jotunn Star route
targets.description: Collect Chilly Chunks, Lantern and Chains; complete the Burial Grounds shrine; escort Astrid and climb the Lighthouse.

targets.title: Crowbar and note candidates
targets.description: Crowbar: Lighthouse shelf. Note candidates: Dry Dock button room or corpse by Tyr’s Foot.

targets.title: Flak round crate candidates
targets.description: Use the note to choose the crate code. Search the Admin corner, boat, VS Recon wall-buy and road trap landmarks; room centers do not identify individual crates.

targets.title: Flak gun and Riese head
targets.description: Use the flak gun near the Lighthouse facing spawn, then recover the Transmitter from the Riese head at the landing.

targets.title: Transmitter delivery
targets.description: Collect from the Riese head, then place it inside Tyr’s head on the second floor.

targets.title: Foundry radio console
targets.description: Use a Molotov to unlock the Ascender. The Amplitude / Frequency console and controller are on the upper walkway.

targets.title: Fishing search areas
targets.description: Eleven published fishing spots, plus rod search areas. Check for the green fish; the Irradiated Ravager later roams and has no fixed pin.

targets.title: Genetic Lab Uranium
targets.description: ARC-XD vent approach, then the jar machine, Necrospike and locked cell in the interior lab.

targets.title: Charge the Atomkraft Core
targets.description: Defend the pallets and generator near Quick Revive, carry the core to the Storm Bridge barrel, then collect the shard near Tyr’s Foot.

targets.title: Blodheim Hall bonfire
targets.description: Place the shard, light the central bonfire, and feed it zombies with a Disciple Injection.

targets.title: Sunstone altar
targets.description: Place the Sunstone at the church center. Rune wood piles appear around the map and are not verified fixed pins.

targets.title: Dravakar encounter launch
targets.description: Interact with Tyr’s Head console to travel to Dravakar’s Fall. Select the boss-arena layer for the encounter layout and traps.

targets.title: Headphone search areas
targets.description: Look on boxes near PhD, near Double Tap, and at the bottom of the Antiquities shelf beside a plate.

targets.title: Gnome statue search areas
targets.description: Upper Workshop sheets, the distant search-light roof from Tyr’s Foot, church altar, and Lighthouse upper catwalk. These are viewpoint areas.

targets.title: Power Switch relic viewpoints
targets.description: Observe the four outside-map structures from these areas, then use the matching bear pelts in Blodheim Hall. The outside structures themselves are not exact pins.

targets.title: Dravakar’s Fall
targets.description: The three traps counter freezing during the fight. Moving heads, weak spots and ice attacks are not fixed markers.

targets.title: Mister Peeks — Cursed reward spawns
targets.description: In tiered Cursed runs, Mister Peeks can briefly appear at a possible spawn. Shoot him for an egg with rewards that can include perks. These pins are candidates, not guaranteed appearances.
